howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 PM PDT 22 August 2026 Tonight and Sunday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southerly inflow 10 to 20 knots except southwesterly inflow 25 over northern sections. Wind becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 this evening then becoming southerly inflow 10 to 20 near noon Sunday. Showers. Risk of thunderstorms late this afternoon and tonight.
